decisions.reason: As an adjacent professional application that still leverages the firm's lighting know-how and institutional customer access, the medical examination light remains worth keeping unless several years of sales have clearly failed to justify its niche position.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's core industrial offer, engineering capabilities and certification strengths so well that management would usually continue this product line unless performance had turned clearly disappointing.

The pendant office luminaire is close to the established commercial lighting business and likely inexpensive to carry, so the option would normally be kept open unless competition and demand have shown it to be persistently weak.

A premium pendant luminaire line with several models broadens the firm's core office and architectural offering and preserves upside in a familiar market, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
